records.title: DEMO: Grid operator outage after coordinated intrusion
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. A fictional national grid operator in Northmark reported a loss of supervisory control at three substations after an intrusion into its operational network, leaving about 180,000 customers without power for up to nine hours. The operator and the national CERT both confirmed the intrusion; attribution remains unestablished.

confirmed_facts.text: The operator lost supervisory control of three substations on 21 November.
Power was restored to all affected customers within nine hours.

reported_claims.text: A hacktivist channel claimed responsibility; the claim has not been verified.

international_perspectives.text: The regional energy regulator described the event as the most serious grid incident in the country this decade.

records.impact_assessment: Observed: nine-hour outage for about 180,000 customers; temporary loss of rail signalling in one city. Potential: repeat intrusion if the initial access path is not identified; knock-on effects on water pumping stations that rely on grid power.
records.priority_rationale: Critical: confirmed disruption of an energy system with cascading effects, active investigation, and two independent confirmations. Media attention was not a factor.
unknowns: Whether other operators in the region were targeted
reassessment_triggers: A second operator reporting similar activity
monitoring_actions: Watch for national CERT technical indicators
Track restoration status of the three substations
Check ThreatWatch for any exploited ICS vulnerability linked to the incident

update_history.summary: Evidence status raised to Confirmed after the national CERT advisory.
Priority raised to CRITICAL after confirmation of rail-signalling impact.

records.title: DEMO: Cross-border artillery exchanges along disputed valley
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. The fictional states of Kestria and Valdor each report artillery fire from the other side of a disputed valley. Casualty figures differ sharply between the two governments and have not been independently verified.

reported_claims.text: Kestria's defence ministry says four soldiers were killed by Valdoran shelling.
Valdor's government says Kestrian forces fired first and that two civilians were injured.

international_perspectives.text: A regional monitoring mission said it was unable to access the area to verify either account.

records.impact_assessment: Observed: displacement of an estimated 3,000 residents (humanitarian agency figure). Potential: wider escalation if regular forces are reinforced; disruption to the valley's hydroelectric plant.
records.priority_rationale: High: credible reports of armed exchanges between state forces with displacement, but casualty claims are contested and no independent verification is available.
monitoring_actions: Track displacement figures from humanitarian agencies

update_history.summary: Trend changed from Stable to Escalating after second day of exchanges.

records.title: DEMO: Flooding cuts fuel and food corridor
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. Seasonal flooding in the fictional Republic of Amaru washed out two bridges on the main inland trade corridor, interrupting fuel and food deliveries to three provinces.

confirmed_facts.text: Two bridges on the main inland corridor were destroyed.
A temporary crossing reopened to light vehicles on 22 November.

international_perspectives.text: A continental body pledged emergency logistics support.

records.impact_assessment: Observed: fuel shortages in three provinces. Potential: food-price increases if heavy-vehicle access is not restored within two weeks.
records.priority_rationale: High: confirmed infrastructure loss affecting supply to a large population; improving with the temporary crossing.

update_history.summary: Trend changed to De-escalating after temporary crossing reopened.

records.title: DEMO: Ransomware disrupts regional hospital network
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. A fictional hospital group diverted ambulances from two emergency departments after ransomware encrypted its scheduling and imaging systems.

confirmed_facts.text: Ambulances were diverted from two emergency departments for 36 hours.

reported_claims.text: A ransomware group listed the hospital group on its leak site.

records.impact_assessment: Observed: delayed elective procedures and ambulance diversion. Potential: exposure of patient data if the leak-site listing is genuine.
records.priority_rationale: High: confirmed disruption of healthcare services; contained to one regional network.
monitoring_actions: Watch for data publication on the leak site

update_history.summary: Added confirmation that ambulance diversion ended.

records.title: DEMO: Satellite navigation interference reported over shipping lane
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. Several commercial vessels reported GNSS position errors in a fictional shipping lane. The source of interference has not been identified.

reported_claims.text: A maritime security centre logged position errors from multiple vessels.

records.impact_assessment: Potential: navigation hazards and delays in a busy lane.
records.priority_rationale: Moderate: reported but unverified interference without incidents so far.
monitoring_actions: Track maritime advisories for the lane

records.title: DEMO: Disputed election results prompt nationwide protests
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. Opposition parties in the fictional state of Costa Verde reject provisional election results; the electoral authority stands by its count. Protests have been largely peaceful.

reported_claims.text: The opposition alleges tally-sheet discrepancies in four districts.
The electoral authority says audits found no material discrepancies.

records.impact_assessment: Observed: peaceful protests in the capital. Potential: unrest if the certification date passes without an agreed audit.
records.priority_rationale: Moderate: contested political situation with limited violence so far.

records.title: DEMO: Autonomous trading agents trigger flash volatility
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. A fictional exchange's post-incident note says interacting autonomous trading agents amplified a 90-second price swing. AEGIS assesses this as an emerging AI-systems risk rather than a malicious event.

reported_claims.text: The exchange attributes the swing to interacting autonomous agents.

records.impact_assessment: Observed: short-lived price disruption; no settlement failures. Potential: larger disruptions as agent adoption grows.
records.priority_rationale: Moderate: emerging systemic risk with limited immediate harm.
monitoring_actions: Follow regulator commentary on autonomous trading controls

records.title: DEMO: Cholera cases rise in displacement camps
records.summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. A humanitarian agency reports suspected cholera cases in camps housing people displaced by flooding.

reported_claims.text: Forty suspected cases have been reported.

records.impact_assessment: Potential: wider outbreak if water and sanitation are not restored.
records.priority_rationale: Low for global security; important locally.
monitoring_actions: Track case counts from health authorities
